summary.method: Path-Alpha full measurement. Six-band signals computed causally as EWMA rolling state (halflife 120s, no fixed snapshot window, no oracle input) from each leg's WS-delta tape. Population: role-resolved events with a formed call_moment. P1 walk-forward-by-date logistic (expanding, min-train 40) on leg-differential band state at call_moment. P2 dip-timing AUC on R3 (49f6501) wrong-phase legs = carried(V28_CARRIED_POSITIVE_LEG) UNION INCUMBENT_FIRST. P3 combined ceiling.

part2_dip_timing.note: Combined predictor is a walk-forward-by-date logistic on the six causal EWMA bands (learned signs; the earlier hand-weighted composite was mis-signed and is discarded). A deeper-dip divot is PRECEDED by demand pressure: cross/lock/bid_dom/ask_stair are the strong positive leading bands.

part3_combined_ceiling.definition: held-out learned role correct AND race_won AND tierA(both floors + read early + chased window)

part2_dip_timing_BAR_ruledJul6.bar: AUC>0.65 AND median lead>4.0s fill latency
